Class ClientPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.clientModelController.ClientPlayer
public class ClientPlayer extends Object
A localized model representation tracking a specific participant's identity, assets, and modifiers.

This class serves as a lightweight, synchronized mirror of a player's server-side attributes within the client-side architecture. It manages credentials (nickname, cosmetic configuration tokens), volatile resource balances (food reserves, absolute score counters), and persistent passive effects unlocked via building interactions (such as developmental star pools or cost-reduction multipliers). These metrics are read directly by rendering view screens to update user-specific UI dashboards.
